mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (as of t-1mo) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 20-day returns, so we predict negative returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, the S&P 500 tends to have negative returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.25, the S&P 500 tends to have negative returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 220.25, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.18 and rising over the last 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to have negative returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher RSAFS (as of t-1mo) is positively correlated with S&P 500 20-day returns, so we predict positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 94.87, the S&P 500 tends to have positive returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 94.87, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both residential sales exceed 380869.0 and industrial production exceeds 94.87, the S&P 500 tends to have positive returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 380869.0 AND INDPRO > 94.87, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (defined by UNRATE > 9.0), the S&P 500 tends to have negative returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as high unemployment regimes, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
